verdict.rationale: LM Studio's local-first design implies user data stays on the device: models run locally, document chat (RAG) works entirely offline, and Bionic's voice and audio data is stated to be processed locally and never leave the device. That keeps data out of reach of model training, but the pack has no explicit no-training statement or opt-out control, and it is unclear whether Bionic's frontier-model mode stays local. Missing for 10: explicit first-party no-training/data-use policy, documented opt-out or telemetry controls, clarity on whether Bionic's frontier-model mode keeps data local, independent corroboration.
